meta.title: ipc.gov.in → Gov.In CMS + DBIM · work breakdown and effort model
meta.basis: Plan Option 3 (adopt Gov.In CMS + DBIM), Option 1 executed unconditionally, Option 4 carried as the named fallback.
meta.three_point: o / m / p are optimistic / most likely / pessimistic. Expected = (o + 4m + p) / 6. Sigma = (p - o) / 6.
meta.note: Stage 1 is the engagement that fits the stated INR 20-30 lakh envelope. Stage 2 is priced but NOT committed: the plan refuses to cost it before Stage 1's inventory lands. Options are excluded from both and priced separately.

quantities.note: Authoring scales with ITEMS, redirect work with URLs, accessibility with TEMPLATES. Costing 1,906 as pages would overstate the content line by about 75%.
quantities.audit_note: First pass reported 1,906/2,851/497; an adversarial re-count found percent-encoding variants counted as distinct paths. Figures here are the de-duplicated ones.

client_effort_pd.triage_sign_off: 40-70 PD of IPC subject-matter time (60-80% of triage is client-side and cannot be bought)
client_effort_pd.content_authoring: See option X.7 — excluded from Stage 1 and Stage 2 on the assumption IPC editors author

destination_measured.architecture: WordPress + ACF per tenant at cms-<name>.digifootprint.gov.in, shared Next.js front end, APISIX gateway, Akamai
destination_measured.redirect_capability: CONFIRMED — /cms/wp-json/redirection/v1 returns 200 with bulk import/export routes
destination_measured.redirect_practice: ZERO — 201 pre-migration URLs across mohfw/meity/msde returned no 301s
destination_measured.status_codes: depth1=200, depth2=200, depth3=404 on all four tenants — the destination reproduces the defect
destination_measured.bulk_import: NONE — CMS Manual v1.0 (May 2025, 95pp): pages are pre-defined and can only be edited
destination_measured.mohfw_cutover: 5-11 April 2026; old URLs did not survive; authored Hindi did not survive
destination_measured.hindi: Runtime Bhashini machine translation, not stored content; all four tenants ship a Bhashini Disclaimer page
destination_measured.annexure_g: Titled 'For Ministry/Departments not onboarded on gov.in CMS Platform' — an Option 4 obligation

unknowns_left_unpriced: Per-document PDF remediation rate — the published 5-15/30-60 minute figures did not survive audit. A one-day sample of 30-50 of IPC's own PDFs would settle it and is the cheapest uncertainty reduction available.
Redirect rows per source path — the circulating GOV.UK 12:1 ratio did not survive audit. Direction holds (rows exceed paths); magnitude is unknown.

procurement.revealed_route: GeM, category 'Hiring of Agency for IT Projects - Milestone basis'. IPC published GEM/2026/B/7781379 on 13-07-2026, estimated value INR 15 lakh, QCBS 70:30, EMD 4%, ePBG 5% for 60 months.
procurement.prequalification: ISO 9001 + ISO 27000 + CMMI Level 3, min 10 IT professionals on payroll, INR 15 lakh min average annual turnover — a bar that excludes the boutique tier this estimate prices.
procurement.financial_powers: IPC bye-laws Schedule-I: Secretary-cum-Scientific Director sanctions scheme expenditure to INR 50 lakh; above that, Chairman of the Governing Body to INR 2 crore, then the Governing Body itself.
procurement.nicsi_route: NICSI's Board-approved SOP permits a work order to empanelled agencies without open tender. The Application and Website Development panel (28 vendors) expires 30-09-2026 with no visible successor.
procurement.rate_card: No NICSI rate card is in the public domain as of 01-09-2026.

risks.risk: Joomla database access refused or delayed; inventory falls back to crawl-only and is reconciled twice
Gov.In CMS intake stalls; the fallback decision has to be worked and defended
True estate materially larger than the ~1,787 working figure
Per-page 301s are contracted but never delivered — capability is confirmed (Redirection plugin REST with bulk import) yet 201 pre-migration URLs across three live tenants returned zero 301s
Retired shallow paths cannot return 404/410 on the destination — MEASURED: all four DBIM reference sites answer 200 at depth 1 and 2, 404 only at depth 3
Client-side triage sign-off slips, extending the management line
Production change windows on the live Joomla are slower than assumed
Devanagari corruption found in source, forcing re-keying rather than transcoding
Platform ingest is hand-authoring — CONFIRMED, not a risk: CMS Manual v1.0 has zero occurrences of bulk/import/CSV. Residual is the supervision overhead
A third audit cycle is required
Applications pulled into scope mid-flight rather than scoped separately
Attrition and re-ramp across a long elapsed programme
EOL Joomla and PHP force a version upgrade rather than a patch
